description: Group B field family: score_moments {mean, std, skew, kurtosis} over a window's prediction scores. std is population stdev (divide by N). skew/kurtosis use the bias-corrected Fisher-Pearson estimators: skew = sqrt(n(n-1))/(n-2) * m3/std^3; excess kurtosis = (n-1)/((n-2)(n-3)) * ((n+1)*g2 + 6) where g2 = m4/std^4 - 3.
